# Media Analysis Fixture

`astronaut.png`: NASA portrait of Eileen Collins, a public-domain NASA image,
distributed as the scikit-image astronaut example.
Source: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.24.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png
Attribution and description: https://scikit-image.org/docs/0.24.x/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut

Used only for local regression tests, never as a user profile or training source.
